scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof valid for all integers \(m\ge2\), with bounded direct computational tests from an included standalone source file. Originality is self-review only; no third-party certification or independent check is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The unknown defective set is only the empty set or exactly one cyclic edge; arbitrary, singleton, and longer positive sets are not decodable by this construction.
No error correction, noise robustness, or positive lower bound on per-item sample replication is claimed.
The count of minimum tests is closely related to previously studied union vertex-distinguishing coloring; the exact aggregate incidence cost and its equality structure are the present claim.
Prior-source comparisons are incomplete for some older and conference works; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp sample-incidence cost for full-capacity cyclic adjacent-pair testing
